description: AGSC-08-26(g) on a Bundle whose one channel has the publish choice auto. The git-log file of AGSC-08-20b holds the root commit, with no trailer, and one later commit made directly on the content branch: one parent, so not a merge commit, and none of the trailers Signed-off-by, Proposal or Channel-Auto. The root commit, which no merge can produce, is exempt; the later commit is AGSC-E706, reported once, as an error. The input is the configuration and the git-log file; the forge-side parts of the clause (reachability from a merged pull request, the forge identity of the author, the bypass list) are not part of the case.
